description_en: Modifies the configuration of an access control policy for a specified VPC firewall policy group
description_zh: 修改指定VPC防火墙策略组的访问控制策略的配置信息
name: ModifyVpcFirewallControlPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message.

Valid values:

zh: Chinese (default)
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

zh：（默认）中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The action that Cloud Firewall performs on traffic that matches the access control policy.

Valid values:

accept: Allows the traffic.
drop: Blocks the traffic.
log: Monitors the traffic
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中访问流量通过云防火墙的方式（动作）。

取值：

accept：放行
drop：拒绝
log：观察
parameters.name: acl_action

parameters.help_en:
The application type supported by the access control policy.

Valid values:

ANY: all application types
FTP
HTTP
HTTPS
MySQL
SMTP
SMTPS
RDP
VNC
SSH
Redis
MQTT
MongoDB
Memcache
SSL
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略支持的应用类型。

取值：

ANY（表示查询所有类型的应用）
FTP
HTTP
HTTPS
MySQL
SMTP
SMTPS
RDP
VNC
SSH
Redis
MQTT
MongoDB
Memcache
SSL
parameters.name: application_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The destination port in the access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略中访问流量的目的端口
parameters.name: dest_port

parameters.help_en:
The destination address in the access control policy.

If DestinationType is set to `net`, Destination is the destination CIDR block.
  
  Example: 10.2.3.0/24

If DestinationType is set to `group`, Destination is the name of the destination address book.

  Example: db_group

If DestinationType is set to `domain`, Destination is the destination domain name.

  Example: *.aliyuncs.com
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址。

当DestinationType为`net`时，Destination为目的CIDR地址。
  
  例如：10.2.3.0/24

当DestinationType为`group`时，Destination为目的地址簿名称。

  例如：db_group

当DestinationType为`domain`时，Destination为目的域名。

  例如：*.aliyuncs.com
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination address in the access control policy.

Valid values:

net: destination CIDR block
group: destination address book
domain: destination domain name
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址类型。

取值：

net：目的网段（CIDR地址）
group：目的地址簿
domain：目的域名
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls at the border. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html operation to obtain the ID.

When the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls protect a CEN instance, set this parameter to the instance ID of the CEN instance.

  Example: cen-ervw0g12b5jbw\\

When the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls protect an Express Connect circuit, set this parameter to the instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls.
  
  Example: vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9\\
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的实例ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html接口获取该ID。

VPC边界防火墙防护云企业网时，该参数值使用云企业网实例ID。

  例如cen-ervw0g12b5jbw\\

VPC边界防火墙防护高速通道时，该参数值使用VPC边界防火墙实例ID。
  
  例如vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9\\
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the security protocol in the access control policy.

Valid values:

ANY: all protocol types
TCP
UDP
ICMP
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中流量访问的安全协议类型。

取值：

ANY（表示查询所有协议类型）
TCP
UDP
ICMP
parameters.name: proto

parameters.help_en:
The source address in the access control policy.

Valid values:

If SourceType is set to `net`, Source is the source CIDR block.

  Example: 10.2.4.0/24

If SourceType is set to `group`, Source is the name of the source address book.

  Example: db_group
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址。

取值：

当SourceType为`net`时，Source为源CIDR地址。

  例如：10.2.4.0/24

当SourceType为`group`时，Source为源地址簿名称。

  例如：db_group
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the access control policy.

You must provide the UUID when you modify the access control policy. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159758.html operation to query the UUID
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的唯一标识ID。

修改访问控制策略时，需要提供该策略的唯一标识ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159758.html接口获取该ID
parameters.name: acl_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The type of the source address in the access control policy.

Valid values:

net: source CIDR block
group: source address book
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址类型。

取值：

net：源网段（CIDR地址）
group：源地址簿
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination port in the access control policy.

Valid values:

port: port
group: port address book
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中访问流量的目的端口类型。

port：端口
group：端口地址簿
parameters.name: dest_port_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the destination port address book in the access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略中访问流量的目的端口地址簿名称
parameters.name: dest_port_group

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the access control policy is enabled. By default, the policy is enabled after it is created. Valid values:

true: enables the access control policy.
false: disables the access control policy
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的启用状态。策略创建后默认启用该策略。取值：

true：启用访问控制策略
false：不启用访问控制策略
parameters.name: release

parameters.help_en: The list of application names
parameters.help_zh: 应用名称列表
parameters.name: application_name_list

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence type of the Policy Validity Period for the access control policy. Valid values:
Permanent: always (default)
None: specified single time
Daily: daily
Weekly: weekly
Monthly: monthly
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复类型。取值：
Permanent（默认）：总是
None：指定单次时间
Daily：每天
Weekly：每周
Monthly：每月
parameters.name: repeat_type

parameters.help_en:
The set of recurrence days for the Policy Validity Period of the access control policy.
If RepeatType is set to `Permanent`, `None`, or `Daily`, RepeatDays is an empty set.
  Example: []
When the Settings for RepeatType are Weekly, RepeatDays cannot be empty.
  Example: [0, 6]
When the Settings for RepeatType are Weekly, duplicate values are not allowed in RepeatDays.
If RepeatType is set to `Monthly`, RepeatDays cannot be empty.
  Example: [1, 31]
When the Settings for RepeatType are Monthly, duplicate values are not allowed in RepeatDays
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复日期集合。
当RepeatType为`Permanent`、`None`、`Daily`时，RepeatDays为空集合。
  例如：[]
当RepeatType为Weekly时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[0, 6]
RepeatType设置为Weekly时，RepeatDays不允许重复。
当RepeatType为`Monthly`时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[1, 31]
RepeatType设置为Monthly时，RepeatDays不允许重复
parameters.name: repeat_days

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence start time when the policy takes effect. Use the 24-hour time format HH:mm, such as 08:00. The time must be on the hour or half hour, and must be at least half an hour earlier than the recurrence end time.
When RepeatType is set to Permanent or None, RepeatStartTime is empty. When RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, RepeatStartTime must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
策略生效的重复开始时间。使用HH:mm格式的24小时制时间，如08:00，必须为整点或半点时间，且小于重复结束时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatStartTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatStartTime必须有值，您需要设置重复开始时间
parameters.name: repeat_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence end time when the policy takes effect. Use the 24-hour time format HH:mm, such as 23:30. The time must be on the hour or half hour, and must be at least half an hour later than the recurrence start time.
When RepeatType is set to Permanent or None, RepeatEndTime is empty. When RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, RepeatEndTime must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
策略生效的重复结束时间。使用HH:mm格式的24小时制时间，如23:30，必须为整点或半点时间，且大于重复开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatEndTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatEndTime必须有值，您需要设置重复结束时间
parameters.name: repeat_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the Policy Validity Period for the access control policy. The value is expressed in the format of a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time must be on the hour or half hour, and must be at least half an hour earlier than the end time.
When RepeatType is set to Permanent, StartTime is empty. When RepeatType is set to None, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, StartTime must be specified, and you must configure the Settings for the start time
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且小于结束时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，StartTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，StartTime必须有值，您需要设置开始时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the Policy Validity Period for the access control policy. The value is expressed in the format of a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The time must be on the hour or half hour, and must be at least half an hour later than the start time.
When RepeatType is set to Permanent, EndTime is empty. When RepeatType is set to None, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, EndTime must be specified, and you must configure the Settings for the end time
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且大于开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，EndTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，EndTime必须有值，您需要设置结束时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The domain name resolution mode of the access control policy. Valid values:

FQDN: FQDN-based resolution
DNS: DNS-based dynamic resolution
FQDN_AND_DNS: FQDN- and DNS-based dynamic resolution
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的域名解析方式。取值：

FQDN：基于FQDN
DNS：基于DNS动态解析
FQDN_AND_DNS：基于FQDN与DNS动态解析
parameters.name: domain_resolve_type
